description: This is a test class for the ResourcesModifiedStrategy class, specifically testing the handling of resource modification events within a policy persistence context. It defines test methods to set up policies and verify permissions are correctly updated.

classes.name: ResourcesModifiedStrategyCreateTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of ResourcesModifiedStrategy when a new resource is added to a policy, ensuring the policy's permissions are correctly updated after the event.

methods.name: getStrategyUnderTest
methods.description: Returns an instance of the ResourcesModifiedStrategy which is being tested.

methods.name: getPolicyEvent
methods.description: Creates a ResourcesModified event with specified instant and policy, representing a resource modification (addition).

methods.name: additionalAssertions
methods.description: Performs additional checks on the policy after the event has been applied, verifying that permissions are correctly updated for both new and removed resources.
